title: Forms: the select control, field errors, skeletons, autocomplete

steps.name: select
steps.lead_notes: First make the one select control complete: opens upward when there is no room below, full keyboard navigation (arrows, Home, End, type-ahead, Esc, Enter), the pop-in, option icons where the reference has them, correct listbox roles. Then replace every native <select> on a reachable surface with it.

gaps.title: SelectField listbox: no upward opening, no keyboard navigation, no Home/End, no type-ahead, no pair icons
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html:9585-9606 openSelectMenu. It opens upward when `below<180&&above>below`, caps maxHeight at min(320, space), focuses the selected option on open, and handles ArrowUp/Down, Home and End in the menu, type-ahead with a 700ms buffer through normalizeSearch, Tab to close, and data-pairs → pairIcon on the trigger and options. It also closes on scroll and resize, and an invalid select focuses the trigger with aria-invalid.
gaps.app_evidence: shell/domain/ui.tsx:201-209 always sets `top: rect.bottom + 6` with no up branch and no maxHeight from available space. There is no keydown handler on the popup, and focus stays on the trigger. Live check: on /app/new-schedule, opening the last select at y=716 placed the popup at 774-832 of 844, and after ArrowDown and End the focus was still `select-trigger`. There is no pair-icon support. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lonorabot/5d377f24-3ac2-5c89-bb02-ed3686a435ad/scratchpad/audit/shots/sheets/p-select-last.png
gaps.owner_sees: Near the bottom of a form a longer list runs off the screen, and keyboard users cannot move through the options.
gaps.fix_plan: Port the reference's openSelectMenu logic into SelectField. Compute `up` and maxHeight from the trigger rect, set top after measuring the menu, focus the aria-selected option on open, and add an onKeyDown on the listbox for arrows, Home, End, Escape, Tab and type-ahead (reuse the Arabic folding normaliser from @lonora/core search). Add an optional `pairs` prop that renders the existing `.pair-ic` (ConnectionPages.tsx:331) before each label. Render the popup with the popover attribute, or portal it to body, so a transformed ancestor such as #dialog (will-change: transform) cannot offset position:fixed when the field is used inside a sheet.
gaps.verifier_note: Same file as gap 5, so land together. The popup is position:fixed inside the form, so inside a sheet a transformed ancestor (#dialog) can offset it. Portaling to body is the safe route. Keep the existing document pointerdown/Escape close handlers consistent with the portal (the outside-click check uses trigger.parentElement.contains). Pair icons only matter if a pair select exists in the app; make that prop optional or skip it.

gaps.title: Native <select> is still used in many forms; only SelectField has the custom listbox
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html:9560-9576 syncSelectMenus plus a MutationObserver (line 9609) convert every <select> in the document into a .select-trigger with a .select-popup listbox. DESIGN_TREE:256 says the same: «قوائم الاختيار في النماذج: نافذة مخصّصة بعرض الحقل…».
gaps.app_evidence: Raw <select> elements in new-shell pages: agent/IdentityPage.tsx:197,219,262 (model and others), agent/GroupPage.tsx:347 (Coordinator), settings/OwnerPage.tsx:212 (Time zone), settings/IntegrationsPage.tsx:427 («Messages reach»). Raw selects in legacy screens still reachable: components/trading/BrokerConnection.tsx:48, AgentMarketPicker.tsx:23, BrokerPairPicker.tsx:80, AgentModelCard.tsx:113, permissions/PermissionEditor.tsx:158-331, AgentPermissions.tsx:792, skills/RevokeVersion.tsx:79, visual/RichResponse.tsx:486 (in chat answers), market/*, charts/*. SelectField (shell/domain/ui.tsx:162) is used only in Tasks, Skills, Goals and Schedules pages.
gaps.owner_sees: Some dropdowns open the glass listbox and others open the operating system's picker, sometimes in the same flow (an agent page against a schedule page).
gaps.fix_plan: Replace each raw select in shell/** with SelectField (or a controlled variant that takes value and onChange plus disabled). For legacy components still rendered (RichResponse in chat, broker form), either switch them to SelectField or add a single global upgrader modelled on the reference's syncSelectMenus inside the shell, which keeps the native select as the form value. Remove the select styling rules in theme.overrides.css:65,243,254 once they are unused.
gaps.verifier_note: Do the shell pages first by switching them to SelectField, which takes value and onChange and keeps a hidden native select for form submit. The legacy components (RichResponse in chat, broker form) are a separate, riskier step. IdentityPage has three selects and may need a disabled prop that SelectField lacks. Overlaps gap 6: improve SelectField (up-open, keyboard) before or together with this, so the new usages benefit.

steps.name: errors-and-loading
steps.lead_notes: One shared way to show an error under its field (message tied to the input with aria-describedby, focus moves to the first invalid field), used by every form. Skeletons use shell/Skeleton.tsx shapes that match each page's real layout.

gaps.title: Field errors are not shown under each field; forms use one summary line, toasts or browser bubbles
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 5539-5557 validateForm(): per invalid input aria-invalid + aria-describedby, a .field-err (alert icon + «هذا الحقل مطلوب.» / «أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا.» / «أدخل N أحرف على الأقل.» …) inserted inside its .field, focus + scroll to the first, warn toast «راجع حقلين قبل الحفظ», errors clear on input; DESIGN_TREE_37.md 401 «خطأ الحقل … رسالة تحت الحقل، والتركيز على أول حقل خاطئ (دون فقاعات المتصفح)».
gaps.app_evidence: AuthFlow.tsx:86-96 sets one error «تحقق من الحقول المحددة.» below the last field, no aria-invalid, no red field border (live: shots/states/app-signin-err-phone.png vs ref-signin-err-phone.png, where both fields turn red with «هذا الحقل مطلوب.» under each); a bad e-mail gets the same generic line. shell/domain/ui.tsx:331 FormPage calls form.reportValidity(), which shows browser bubbles (tasks, files, skills, goals/knowledge forms). ConnectionPages.tsx:617-621 and 745-754 validate with toasts only. IdentityPage.tsx:177/191 and GroupPage.tsx:304 use <small className="field-err"> without the icon or aria wiring.
gaps.owner_sees: Submitting an incomplete form either shows a vague single line, a browser tooltip, or a toast, never the red field with its own message seen in the reference; each form behaves differently.
gaps.fix_plan: Add one helper (e.g. apps/web/src/shell/forms.ts validateForm(form) + an input listener) that ports reference 5539-5557 with Lingui messages, and call it from AuthFlow.run, FormPage.onSubmit (replacing reportValidity), the provider and MCP forms (express their rules as required/minlength/pattern attributes), and Identity/Group pages; keep the warn toast and vibrate. Server errors (wrong password) stay as the single line under the form.
gaps.verifier_note: Add one shared helper, e.g. shell/forms.ts, and call it from AuthFlow.run and FormPage. Do not rewrite every form in this pass. The provider and MCP forms that validate by toast in ConnectionPages are optional follow-ups. Use Lingui messages for the texts. Keep server errors such as a wrong password as a single line under the form. Make sure the shell CSS already styles .field-err and [aria-invalid]. Check the auth and form e2e tests that look for the old summary text. No money-safety risk.

gaps.title: Several data pages show a blank area while loading instead of a skeleton
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 7302 SK_PAGES has skeletons for usage, providers, mcps, integrations, account, storage, help, identity, owner, plans, activity…; 5580 pageSafe renders skBusy(SK_PAGES[r]()) with role=status aria-busy aria-label «جارٍ التحميل»; DESIGN_TREE_37.md 395 «32 صفحة».
gaps.app_evidence: No SkPage in UsagePage.tsx (531-560: renders filter + «تصدير CSV» only until series arrives), ConnectionPages.tsx:589 ProvidersPage (`providers.loading ? null`), IntegrationsPage.tsx:42, OwnerPage.tsx, AgentsPage.tsx. Live with the APIs delayed 3s: /app/usage shows only the period filter and CSV button over an empty page (shots/states/app-loading_app_usage.png), /app/providers only «إضافة مزود»; aria-busy count 0 on all of them.
gaps.owner_sees: Opening الاستهلاك or مزوّدو النماذج on a slow link shows an empty page with a lone button, then content pops in.
gaps.fix_plan: Add page-shaped skeletons to Skeleton.tsx (usage: hero + chart + KPI tiles + ranked rows; providers/integrations/mcps: grouped rows via SkRows; owner/identity: hero circle + fields) following reference skeleton builders near 7284-7330, and render them in each page while the first load is pending.
gaps.verifier_note: Reuse the existing SkPage and SkRows from shell/Skeleton.tsx and keep it minimal, for example SkRows inside the page while useLoad.loading is true and value is undefined. Do not build bespoke page-shaped skeletons for each page. Check each page's loading flag first, because data on some pages comes from useShellData and is not a loading state. Pages are only blank briefly, so this is not medium.

gaps.title: Form fields: old screens lack id/name; text inputs on new pages lack autocomplete
gaps.reference_evidence: Reference F() helper gives every field a name (e.g. 3691 F("الاسم","name",…)). Comparison report row 49.
gaps.app_evidence: Live probe (scripts/clean/legacy.out): unnamed fields only on old surfaces: market 7/8, trading 4/5, settings?tab=models 2-4, tab=trading 3, memory 1. Text inputs without autocomplete on owner (2), new-skill (2), new-schedule (2), identity (2), mcp (1), new-task (1), new-goal (1), so Chrome may offer address autofill on agent names.
gaps.owner_sees: Browser autofill suggestions popping up on agent and skill names; DevTools issues.
gaps.fix_plan: The old-surface fields disappear with those screens. For the new forms, add autoComplete="off" (or "name" for the owner's name) in the shared field helpers in shell/settings/ui.tsx and shell/domain form components.
gaps.verifier_note: There is no shared input helper in settings/ui.tsx (it exports NavRow, Toggle and similar), so the fix has to go per form: add autoComplete="off" to the named inputs, and "name" on the owner name. Add id/name only to the new forms. The old-surface fields go away with gap 11.
